ledger: blue shirt | hanging on left wall | hanging on right wall next to picture | teleports across the room
intercom panel | not visible | appears on left wall | sudden appearance

findings.description: In the initial shot, the blue shirt is hanging on the left side of the room, while the framed picture is on the right side. When the camera angle changes as the man turns, the blue shirt is suddenly hanging on the right side of the screen, directly next to the framed picture.
A brass intercom panel suddenly appears on the wall to the left of the door when the camera angle changes, which was not visible in the initial establishing shot of that area.
